values.task_boundary: Implement only the #483 read-only corporate custody register and action list within owned documentation/evidence paths.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: The register covers every critical-service class derived from CORP-A and records accepted, follow-up-required, or out-of-scope disposition truthfully.
AC-2: The five completed domain registration transfers are recorded factually without claiming hosted-zone or DNS migration.
AC-3: Remaining service moves and custody gaps have a concise later owner and action list.
AC-4: Repository artifacts contain no credentials, PII, payment data, tax data, private instruments, or recovery material.
AC-5: The PR explicitly records the narrowed read-only boundary and does not overclaim live recovery or break-glass exercises.
non_goals: No account, admin, billing, MFA, recovery, vault, break-glass, secret, or infrastructure mutation
No scheduling of v-*.ai backlog domains
